title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Good evening from Comerica Park, where there is baseball I’m told.
It’s not good, but I need to do something today.
There’s no way you’er really considering that
I’m considering something from my personal account, hell yeah.
Been thinking about doing one every single home game.
But at some point I would be honored if you acknowledged I pioneered the “Good afternoon” trend
I know it’s a gray area and I did not invent the “good afternoon” greeting
But at some point a couple years ago, it became my consistent introduction to a day at the ballpark!
Look at all the African Americans and diversity in the tigers pregame video
Kaline family thing is awkward as shit
